### `class RecipeRegistration` — `src/main/java/synthetic_diamonds/recipe/RecipeRegistration.java`
Registers synthetic_diamonds:weighted_pressing into vanilla's own recipe serializer registry (`docs/spec/contracts/public-surface.md` `SURFACE-REQ-001`) — an ordinary Registry.register call, no Create Fly API and no RecipeType registration of its own (`docs/spec/domains/roll.md` `ROLL-REQ-005`).
- `void register()`

### `class WeightedPressingRecipe` — `src/main/java/synthetic_diamonds/recipe/WeightedPressingRecipe.java`
The exclusive-roll pressing recipe (`docs/spec/domains/roll.md` `ROLL-REQ-001`, `ROLL-REQ-002`): getType() returns the literal AllRecipeTypes.PRESSING static field, so a real MechanicalPressBlockEntity finds this class through its ordinary RecipeManager/RecipeMap lookup with zero mixin (`docs/spec/04-architecture.md` `ARCH-DEC-001`, `ARCH-DEC-002`), and assemble performs one weighted pick over diamond/flint/gunpowder in place of Create Fly's shared independent-roll default.
